---
title: "SHANK3 ASO RNA Structure Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (file.exists("_config.yml")) getwd() else if (file.exists("../_config.yml")) normalizePath("..") else getwd()
struct <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/03_rna_structure.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
acc <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/03_accessibility.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cmds <- tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "logs/03_vienna_commands.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
```

# ViennaRNA status

Structure predictions use `RNAfold` / `RNAplfold` via `system2()` only. Values are **canonical RNA approximations** and are **not** exact biochemical measurements for PS / 2'-MOE / 5m-dC ASOs.

```{r}
if (!is.null(cmds)) knitr::kable(cmds) else cat("No command log.")
```

# Structure table

```{r}
knitr::kable(struct)
```

# Accessibility

```{r}
knitr::kable(acc)
```

# Figures

```{r, results='asis'}
figs <- list.files(file.path(root, "figures/03_structure"), pattern = "[.]png$", full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(figs)) {
  cat("No structure figures (ViennaRNA missing or no windows).\n")
} else {
  for (f in figs) cat("![](", f, ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
